legend.energy.krCapacityNote: Most OSM features lack capacity tags; untagged ones use the smallest circle (not zero)
legend.energy.krPlantsCoverage: OSM roughly matches official (EPSIS) capacity for large thermal and nuclear plants, but covers very little of solar and other small facilities: tagged capacity is only about 2% of the official total
legend.energy.krPlantsOverlap: Solar and hydro sites can appear in both this layer and the renewable-sites layer; not de-duplicated
legend.energy.krRenewCoverage: Wind turbine capacity is mostly tagged; most solar arrays have no capacity (smallest circle) and small rooftop solar is barely mapped in OSM
legend.energy.krStatsNotOnMap: Municipality-level renewable statistics (Korea Energy Agency) are not on this map; they will go to the statistics entry
legend.energy.krGridNote: OSM supplement: transmission (154/345/765 kV) is fairly complete, distribution lines (22.9 kV and below) are almost unmapped; official coordinates are not published
legend.energy.krFuelScope: Covers 16/16 provinces. Ordinary petrol stations (address list only) and the Korea Environment Corporation's nationwide EV chargers (API key required) are not covered; no CNG/LNG in Jeju; EV is KEPCO chargers only
legend.energy.krFuelDates: Data dates: LPG 2026-09, CNG/LNG 2026-09, hydrogen 2026-08, EV 2025-12
legend.energy.krOgSparse: OSM supplement (sparse coverage, not a complete inventory)
legend.energy.krOgScope: Facilities cover 12/16 provinces, pipelines only 4/16; large refineries such as SK Ulsan and GS Caltex Yeosu are mostly not tagged as refineries; no official coordinates to compare against
legend.energy.krOgNoSubstance: The 356 pipelines without a substance tag are excluded rather than guessed
